name: turbo-notify
description: Connect your WhatsApp number to your AI agent: send and read messages, and run a virtual attendant that answers your customers.

interface.longDescription:
Summarize your WhatsApp chats and groups, send WhatsApp messages and read what customers wrote, from your AI agent and with your own WhatsApp number. Ask who is waiting for a reply and which payments and deadlines came up, send a message, or check whether it was delivered.

The plugin also includes the virtual attendant, a skill that answers your customers on WhatsApp from what you teach it about your business and hands the conversation to a person when it cannot help. It runs on your computer with Codex, keeps its notes in a folder you own, and starts in a mode where you approve every answer. It only answers while Codex is running on your computer.

You need a Turbo Notify account with a WhatsApp number linked in the dashboard. Sign in with that account the first time the plugin is used. The plugin works only with your WhatsApp number on Turbo Notify.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my WhatsApp: who is waiting for a reply, plus payments and deadlines.
Every day at 7 pm, summarize my WhatsApp and list what I still have to answer.
Twice a day, at 7 am and 7 pm, recap what is new in my WhatsApp groups and chats.
